assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one finished attendance-event HUD icon for HELLSCRIPT, a dark fantasy action RPG. Generate a new icon, not a UI screenshot. Use the native GPT Image surface, gpt-image-2 if the surface allows a model selection. A single round aged-brass medallion, straight front view, centered and occupying 88% of a square canvas. A restrained thick gold/brass beveled circular rim with four tiny compass-point studs, matching premium dark gothic game menu emblems. Inside the medallion is one clearly readable ivory parchment calendar page with two dark brass binding rings, a simple 2 by 3 grid of large blank day squares, and one large emerald-green check mark over a day square. In front of the calendar at lower right is a small closed reward chest made of black iron and antique gold, integrated as part of this one compact emblem. The calendar must dominate and the chest must remain secondary; strong bold forms legible when shrunk to 44 pixels. Painterly realistic material treatment, warm gold edge lighting, dark charcoal/olive inner medallion surface, subtle parchment wear. No text, letters, numerals, logos, words, watermarks, extra badges, sparkles or scenery. Deliver an actual transparent PNG with preserved native alpha: fully transparent surrounding space outside the isolated medallion and any internal empty space. No black, white or colored background, no checkerboard, no floor, no cast shadow, no glow extending outside the rim. Preserve clean antialiased alpha edges without matte or halo.
